dt: QIS proposals accepted anytime under NSF 26-523. The PIF program page lists no PIF topic open for proposals.
e: Faculty PIs. PIF covers computing and data science for physics; QIS covers quantum information science. QIS is an option for quantum-sensing or AI/ML work in particle and nuclear physics; PIF takes proposals only in announced topics.
n: NSF MPS Physics: Physics at the Information Frontier (PIF) and QIS
